definition.value: Varenicline, relative to placebo, significantly reduced ALC – BEV activation in the left and right OFC; the effect was not observed in other brain areas.

value: Varenicline did, however, increase self-reported control over alcohol-related thoughts and reduced cue-elicited activation bilaterally in the OFC, but not in other brain areas.
